answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments tethered to sequential delay primitives impede identity spoofing by preventing an adversary from spiraling clones, rendering the creation of a single valid staking relic computationally infeasible. High staking collateral coupled with severe slashing penalties generates a robust Nash equilibrium where any malicious attempt to disrupt consensus ripples seamlessly into economic ruin. Establishing cryptographic finality ensures this self-enforcing security model remains closed against decentralized attacks.
